moral.zh: 雪由许多冰晶和空气空隙组成，光被反射、折射并向各处散射，各种可见光大致一起进入眼睛，所以雪看起来是白色的。
moral.en: Many ice crystals and air gaps scatter light in many directions, making snow look white.

pages.enText: A snowflake landed in Mimi’s mitten. She looked up and asked, “Why is snow white?”
